title: actor
description: Any actor by label: a basic shape, an asset or a class, at a transform. Converges: a moved actor is moved back, a changed class respawns it (WP11 generic kind until WP6's layout kinds).

name.description: the actor label (unique in the level)

shape.description: an engine basic shape (100 cm at scale 1)

asset.description: a static mesh or Blueprint, /Game/... or /Engine/...

cls.description: an actor class: RectLight, CineCameraActor, PostProcessVolume, ...

look_at.description: [x, y, z] cm: aim the actor there (instead of rot)

size.description: [x, y, z] cm, for basic shapes (scale = size / 100)

scale.description: a factor or [x, y, z] factors

material.description: a material for its static meshes, /Game/...
